correctness.rationale: The published period-three run-transform theorem supplies exact term support. A constructive three-state length recursion, explicit maximum and boundary-gap calculations and an exact tribonacci gap-multiset recurrence prove all positive-distance classifications and generating functions for every integer length. A simple dominant tribonacci pole gives each fixed-gap dyadic-prefix frequency; since 2/lambda>1, its mean diverges. The standalone checker directly verifies 301 distinct defining binomial values and all 121395 adjacent gaps through length eighteen; the infinite proof does not depend on finite tests.
